name: wheel load reduction rate
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 车轮垂向荷载相对于参考轮重的减少比例。
usage_overview: 用于评价轮载减小所反映的车辆运行安全状态，比较轨道不平顺、基础条件及外部激励的影响，也可与脱轨系数共同用于脱轨分析。短波接触作用会影响该指标；将其用于不平顺界限谱约束时，短波表达不足可能限制其适用，评价限值也随具体分析设定而异。

complete_examples.text: Secondly, according to the train running safety standard of GB5599-85 [30] and UIC518 [31], some traditional train running safety indexes such as derailment coefficient, wheel load reduction rate and wheel axle lateral force have been studied a lot.
The maximum rail displacements, the maximum derailment coefficient, the maximum wheel load reduction rate, and the Sperling index varying with the different months are shown in Fig. 17.
For the wheel load reduction rate, as shown in Fig. 17(c), its evolution trend is also similar to the frost heave deformation.
